reason: Greptile finding (PR #1687): the webhook token is substituted into the request path and was emitted in plaintext in the JSON envelope, dry-run stderr, and client error text. Added Client.AddPathCredential so path-embedded secrets are redacted by displayURL/maskError/dry-run output, and the execute command now emits a redacted path in its envelope.
validated_outcome: live dogfood PASS 457/457 after fix; dry-run and 404 error paths both show /webhooks/<id>/**** with the token redacted
upstream_issue: Candidate generator change: emit AddPathCredential automatically for spec paths whose security or path params embed credentials (e.g. webhook token path params).
